name: Perlin Absolute Noise (Turbulence)
definition: A variant of fBm using Perlin noise where the absolute value of each octave is taken before summing, creating a 'turbulent' appearance.
summary: Perlin Absolute Noise, or Turbulence, sums the absolute values of Perlin noise octaves to create billowy, cloudy textures with derivative discontinuities, unlike the smoother standard fBm.
